name: Incyte
description: Incyte is a cancer and inflammation drug company that is already a profitable commercial business: 2025 revenue was $5.14 billion and operating income $1.51 billion. 60% of revenue comes from one drug, Jakafi (ruxolitinib), a blood-cancer and graft-versus-host pill sold in the U.S., with Novartis selling it abroad as Jakavi and paying Incyte a royalty. Opzelura cream, newer oncology drugs (Monjuvi, Niktimvo, Zynyz) and royalties from Novartis and Lilly make up the rest. Jakafi's key patents expire in mid and late 2028, so growth of the newer products is the question. It has never paid a dividend.

employees.note: Up about 9% from 2,617 a year earlier.

businessLines.name: Jakafi (ruxolitinib, U.S.)
businessLines.how: Sells a twice-daily pill for myelofibrosis, polycythemia vera and graft-versus-host disease to U.S. patients through specialty pharmacies and distributors, net of rebates and discounts; revenue follows paid patient demand. Incyte keeps the U.S. rights; outside the U.S. Novartis sells it as Jakavi.

businessLines.name: Opzelura (ruxolitinib cream)
businessLines.how: Sells a prescription cream for atopic dermatitis and vitiligo, billed through U.S. pharmacy channels; revenue grows with patient demand and refills.

businessLines.name: Other marketed products (Iclusig, Pemazyre, Monjuvi/Minjuvi, Niktimvo, Zynyz)
businessLines.how: Sells specialty oncology and chronic-GVHD drugs (Iclusig $134.1M, Pemazyre $86.7M, Monjuvi/Minjuvi $144.6M, Niktimvo $151.6M, Zynyz $66.3M) through specialty distributors; each is a small, newer or niche drug.

businessLines.name: Product royalties
businessLines.how: Receives a percentage royalty on partners' sales: Novartis on Jakavi ($457.7M) and Tabrecta ($26.7M), Lilly on Olumiant ($144.6M), other $7.9M; no cost of goods, but royalty expense of $124.6M is paid on some of it.

businessLines.name: Milestone and contract revenues
businessLines.how: One-off payments from collaboration partners when development or sales targets are met; lumpy and not recurring.

brands.name: Jakafi, Opzelura, Iclusig, Pemazyre, Monjuvi, Niktimvo, Zynyz
brands.note: Product revenues shown in the business lines.

whatsNext.text: Jakafi composition-of-matter and use patents (including extensions) expire in mid and late 2028; the 10-K lists estimated minimum market exclusivity dates of 2028.
Phase 2 trial of axatilimab plus ruxolitinib in newly diagnosed chronic GVHD has results anticipated in early 2027.
